HOW

Where the interactivity actually comes from.

Instagram counts every tap on a story as engagement, and ranks the account on it. Nineteen of the twenty-five frames get a native sticker, added in the Instagram app when posting; the frames themselves stay clean. Which one, and why, per type:

Countdownd1-1, d2-3Tap to get reminded. Instagram sends a notification at zero, which is a launch-morning push you did not have to write.
Polld1-2, d4-1, d4-3, d6-4Lowest-friction tap on the platform. Results are content for the next frame, so every poll here has a payoff the day after.
Emoji sliderd1-3, d4-2Even lower friction than a poll. Good for frames that are really just a photograph you want people to sit with.
Quizd2-2, d5-4Smuggles a fact in as a game. The two here carry the range of their work and the 450+ figure.
Question boxd4-4, d5-3, d7-1Replies arrive as DMs, which is where a lead should arrive. Answer some publicly on Day 6; the rest are a conversation.
Add Yoursd3-4Chains follower photos onto the launch. 450+ past clients is a lot of camera rolls. Reshare the best through the week.
Linkd3-1, d3-3, d7-3, d7-4The whole point of the week. Big, centred, never the same frame as a poll, so nothing competes with it.
Noned2-1, d5-1, d5-2, d6-1, d6-2, d7-2Reveal, quotes and numbers get no sticker. The reaction bar is enough; a poll on a testimonial cheapens it.
RULES

Five things that make the week work.

Every poll pays off

Day 1's guess is answered on Day 2. Day 3's "which first" decides Day 4's order. Day 6's "one of yours?" tells Day 7 who to speak to. Nothing is asked for its own sake.

Link sticker gets a clean frame

Never on the same frame as a poll or a slider. On launch day it is the biggest thing on screen and it is there three times.

Answer the question boxes

Day 4 and Day 5 open two of them. Reply to a handful publicly on Day 6 in the "You asked" template, and reply to the rest in DMs the same day. Unanswered boxes read as an unanswered phone.

Pin two frames as a highlight

The launch frame (D3-1) and the closer (D7-4) go into a "New home" highlight before the week ends, so the link outlives the 24 hours.

Stickers go on in Instagram

Every frame is a clean 1080×1920 image. The sticker to add, and its options where it has them, is written under each frame. D6-3 is a template to answer questions in; everything else is ready to post as drawn.

Pouring our Heart & Soul into turning your dreams to reality.
Frames are drafts at 1080×1920. Stickers shown are mock-ups; the real ones are added in the Instagram app when posting. Photographs are Soul Events' own, from the event decks supplied on 6 September.
